attributes.cardDescription: A genuinely reusable marketplace-seller building block — identity plus a numeric rating — not a Sole Vault–specific concept. Extends the app's own MarketplaceMember (itself a subclass of the pulled matrix Person block) so it inherits the dark-luxury views for free.
attributes.readMe:
### Why a subclass of MarketplaceMember, not of PersonBase directly

The reusable *essence* of this block is the schema (person identity + rating), not these specific views. Extending `MarketplaceMember` inherits the dark-luxury isolated/edit/fitted templates for free rather than duplicating ~400 lines of near-identical markup; a consuming app in a different visual world would override the formats the same way any card override works — same as `MarketplaceMember` itself overrides `PersonBase`'s plain `embedded`.

### Split from MarketplaceMember on purpose

`rating` has no meaning on a buyer. `Order.buyer`, `Offer.offeredBy` and `CollectionItem.owner` narrow to plain `MarketplaceMember`; only `Order.seller` and `Listing.seller` narrow to `SellerProfile`. One real-world person can still be linked from both kinds of field on different cards — a `SellerProfile` instance satisfies a `MarketplaceMember`-typed link too, since it is one via inheritance.

### Non-goals

This card does not carry review text, only the aggregate numeric rating (written reviews are a separate concept). It does not distinguish a permanent seller identity from a one-off listing — a person becomes "a seller" simply by being the target of a `seller` link, not by any flag on this card itself.
